newsitem.title: UK: LPC - NatWest Markets loses two executives to CSFB.
newsitem.headline: LPC - NatWest Markets loses two executives to CSFB.

text.p: LONDON, July 31 (LPC) - Grant Johnson, formerly syndications chief at NatWest Markets, has joined Credit Suisse First Boston as Managing Director and Head of Loan Syndications, CSFB announced today.

Johnson, who was also a member of NatWest's Management Committee for Global Debt Markets and Global Head of Global Syndications, will be joined by NatWest colleague David Slade, who has been appointed Director of Loan Syndications. At NatWest, Slade was Director of High Yield Finance and head of European Origination.
The departures from NatWest will hit the syndications team hard, and may continue according to one banker who said that "there are a lot of unhappy people over there right now."

Johnson and Slade's defection from NatWest means the bank has lost three high-profile members of its syndications team in the last two months. In June, Gary Griffiths joined Dutch investment bank ABN-AMRO to head up its London syndication team.

Tony Rhodes, former Head of Loan Syndications at CSFB, and Simon Jackson, a director in the syndications team, have both left the firm. Their departure came as a surprise to the market. "Its shocking," commented one banker. "I think they've been doing a good job over there."

Also joining the CSFB team is Richard Atterbury who will join the Origination and Acquisition Finance Team as Managing Director. Atterbury was formerly a Senior Managing Director with Bank of America in Chicago where he handled private equity clients and syndicated loan and high yield bond offerings.
